integrity: An exact proof is accompanied by separate finite exact-rational and brute-force tests. Finite checks do not imply the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Applies to positive integer input and positive integral preimages of one-prime arithmetic partial derivative only. Individual density masses are given by a convergent effective series, not claimed elementary. Positive support uses Emmons--Xiao (2022) Theorem 21; independent audit not performed.
title: Natural-density distribution of integer anti-partial derivative multiplicities
